description: Search the public SwiftSkills catalog. query is a case-insensitive substring (max 200 characters). category is an optional category slug. type is an optional kind: skill, mcp, rules, docs, or sdk. Returns name, slug, type, category, summary, and url. Every url includes utm_source=mcp and utm_medium=tool. At most 50 rows are returned; total counts the rest.
name: search_entries
title: Search entries
